title: No kbd shortcuts with Golden Gate
summary: Yesterday I updated to Golden Gate i.e. MacOS 27.0.1 and today my NewsBlur keyboard shortcuts don’t work, the app makes a beep sound whenever I touch the keyboard. Coincidence? I couldn’t find keyboard settings in a quick tour of the prefs but maybe I missed it.
body_markdown:
[TimBray](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/TimBray)


October 11, 2026, 5:18pm 1


Yesterday I updated to Golden Gate i.e. MacOS 27.0.1 and today my NewsBlur keyboard shortcuts don’t work, the app makes a beep sound whenever I touch the keyboard. Coincidence? I couldn’t find keyboard settings in a quick tour of the prefs but maybe I missed it.


[TimBray](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/TimBray)


October 11, 2026, 5:20pm 2


Oops, just some of them. V to view an article in a browser, J to move down the list.


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


October 11, 2026, 6:46pm 3


I’m a little behind on updating the macOS app but I thought we fixed keyboard shortcuts a couple weeks ago. I’ll take another look and push out a release later this week.


[TimBray](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/TimBray)


October 11, 2026, 7:44pm 4


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


October 12, 2026, 7:52pm 5


Found it. J, V, and the other single key story shortcuts only worked when the story itself had keyboard focus. Once you clicked a story title in the list, focus stayed on the list and those keys had nowhere to go, so the Mac beeped. The arrow keys kept working because the list handles them itself. The next Mac release makes every story shortcut work no matter which pane has focus. Should be in a couple days I think.
